# Lorna Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** 28 years old  <sub>[v2 c10 P49](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c38 P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls Harbor  <sub>[v2 c6 P1](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0001), [v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher; homemaker  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P22](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0022)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mrs. Rufus Vane  <sub>[v2 c1 P42](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0042), [v2 c6 P60](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0060)</sub>; Sea-queen  <sub>[v4 c23 P28](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Lorna Ainslie  <sub>[v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Lorna possesses a tall, splendid figure with cream-white skin and a delicate face. She has large, deep blue eyes, a small, dark-lashed, expressive mouth, and thick, shiny, golden-brown hair that reaches down to her feet when unbound. She often wears a simple cream or blue dress with a splash of crimson or red, such as a rose or ribbon.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c6 P11](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0011), [v2 c6 P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P39](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0039), [v2 c13 P5](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0005), [v2 c23 P24](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0024), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028), [v3 c33 P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v3 c33 P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)_

## Personality

Lorna possesses a deep, fiery, and passionate nature hidden beneath a reserved and aloof exterior. She is intensely loyal to her loved ones, demonstrating great courage, fortitude, and self-sacrifice. Though she occasionally struggles with feelings of envy or bitterness over her difficult life, she has a rich inner capacity for joy, laughter, and appreciation of beauty. She prefers to keep her deepest griefs private rather than complain or seek sympathy.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P28](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0028), [v2 c11 P30](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0030), [v2 c13 P7](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0007), [v2 c13 P10](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0010), [v2 c21 P20](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0020), [v2 c21 P21](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0021), [v2 c21 P25](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0025), [v2 c23 P28](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0028)_

## History

Lorna grew up in Seven Gulls Harbor, enduring the tragic deaths of her brother and father during her youth. To save her mother from losing her farm, Lorna sacrificed her academic ambitions at age sixteen to marry Rufus Vane. Shortly after her mother's death, Rufus went missing at sea; he was eventually brought back by Captain Saul as an amnesiac, whom Lorna devotedly nursed for eleven years. After forming a deep friendship with Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow, Hugh discovered that the man in Lorna's care could potentially be cured through brain surgery. The operation in Montreal succeeded, revealing a shocking truth: the man was actually Laurence Vane, Rufus's cousin, while Rufus himself had died of yellow fever years prior in Cuba. Free at last, Lorna returned home and admitted her long-suppressed love for journalist Adrian Treleaven, who had fallen in love with her while writing a book with Captain Saul. The two were eventually engaged and planned to marry before moving away together.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015), [v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016), [v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020), [v2 c11 P22](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0022), [v2 c11 P23](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0023), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027), [v2 c11 P28](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0028), [v2 c11 P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033), [v2 c11 P35](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0035), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c36 P24](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0024), [v4 c38 P8](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0008), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank Ainslie, a scholar-farmer, and Rose Kerr, a noted local beauty  <sub>[v2 c11 P15](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Tragically lost her younger brother Julian in a farm accident when she was twelve years old  <sub>[v2 c11 P16](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Discovered her father's body after he committed suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v2 c11 P20](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Regent's Academy and became the schoolteacher at the Glen  <sub>[v2 c11 P22](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Coerced into marrying Rufus Vane at sixteen to save her mother from foreclosure  <sub>[v2 c11 P23](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0023), [v2 c11 P27](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Spent eleven years caring for a brain-damaged man believed to be her husband  <sub>[v2 c11 P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033), [v2 c11 P35](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0035)</sub>

> Red roses mean love triumphant.  <sub>[v4 c38 P8](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0008)</sub>
